steps.comment: scrape the filename cell (the SCRAPED name, distinct from the download's HTTP-suggested name)
download hashes the bytes and streams to the store; idempotent by content identity

push.value: { attachmentId: dl.contentId, filename: filename, internalFilename: string(dl.contentId) + (contains(filename,'.') ? '.' + substringAfterLast(filename,'.') : ''), sha256: dl.sha256, sizeBytes: dl.sizeBytes, storedAs: dl.storedAs, stored: dl.stored }

steps.comment: second download of the SAME content short-circuits on exists() → stored:true, no re-upload

push.value: { attachmentId: dl2.contentId, filename: filename, internalFilename: string(dl2.contentId) + (contains(filename,'.') ? '.' + substringAfterLast(filename,'.') : ''), sha256: dl2.sha256, sizeBytes: dl2.sizeBytes, storedAs: dl2.storedAs, stored: dl2.stored }
